cues.text: If you haven’t found the perfect physical activity yet, here are some things to think
about. The first question is whether you would enjoy training in a gym.
Many people are put off by the idea of fitting gym visits into a busy day.
With regular training in a gym, you’ll see a big difference in a relatively short space
of time.
Running has become incredibly popular because it’s a very accessible form of exercise
that anyone can do, even if you can only run a few metres to begin with.
Swimming is another really good way to build fitness.
What attracts many people is that you can swim in an indoor pool at any time of year,
although it can feel boring or solitary.
Cycling has become almost as popular as running.
Many people say being out in the fresh air in a park or in the countryside can be fun,
provided the conditions are right.
Yoga is a good choice if you want exercise that develops both a healthy mind and body.
With the right instructor there’s less chance of hurting yourself than with other more
active sports.
Getting a personal trainer is a good way to start your fitness programme.
If you’ve got someone there to encourage you and help you achieve your goals, you’re less
likely to give up.
People often waste money on gym membership and then hardly ever go.
I think people lose interest when they don’t think they’re making enough progress.
Also, lots of people don’t have the determination and hard work to keep training week
after week.
One thing you can do is to set manageable goals, be realistic and don’t push yourself too
far. Give yourself a really nice treat every time you reach one of your goals.
